description: Welcome to your bright and beautifully updated Tarzana retreat! This 2-bedroom, 2-bath upper-level condo offers a perfect blend of comfort, modern finishes, and convenience. Step inside to discover a spacious open-concept layout. The kitchen opens seamlessly to the dining and living areas making it ideal for entertaining or relaxing at home. Enjoy your morning coffee or unwind in the evening on your private balcony. The primary suite offers a serene escape with its own en-suite bathroom, while the second bedroom provides flexibility for guests, a home office, or creative space. Community features a pool, spa, and landscaped courtyards. Just moments from Ventura Blvd's best dining, shops, and cafes plus easy access to the 101 freeway, this condo truly offers style, comfort, and convenience in one package. HOA dues include water, trash, sewer, landscaping, pool and spa maintenance, building insurance, exterior maintenance, pest control, and professional management. Two parking spots (tandem) and storage.
